title: A Compass for the Passage
author: Isandro Coldharbour
blurb: Sable Coldharbour, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
